== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian: the entry “Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary'', Version 2.0 (November 1998), PDF page 49. Image for [[Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian (Decipher Errata 1998)]].

Source: [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf swccgglossary.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf 20061215115652]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>b3838634d3e1379e527f0914f7816f5b0c130c89</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 49 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a 6-point margin.

SHA-1 <code>4a48902d6d14fb2d2cd8ecb85330187bb6da662e</code>, SHA-256 <code>c1d7562f4d0474bef0bf4339b1f1c26f3f6be24a08799e1e8a9c96525854e3ca</code>.
